title: Average marks in an economics test
body: A teacher records the marks (out of 40) of 20 students in an economics test as a continuous series: 0-10: 4 students; 10-20: 6 students; 20-30: 8 students; 30-40: 2 students. She wants to find the average marks and decides to save effort by using the step deviation method, taking the mid-point 25 as the assumed mean A and the common class width 10 as c. She will then check her answer with the direct method using the sum of fm.
